status: pre-inference protocol; no model outputs inspected for this dataset
scope: Separate empirical post-hoc raw-score operating-point pilot, not probability calibration or FireTV certification

data.source: Official COCO2017 val human keypoint annotations, never COCO train
data.backgroundGroundTruth: zero person annotations plus independent model-blind visual confirmation of no real people; annotations alone insufficient
data.split: 53 person calibration and35 person heldout, plus20/20 background; grouped by original source image and exact/near-duplicate family; deterministic label-only ranking frozen before inference
data.manifestBindingRule: Fill exact immutable manifest SHA before any batch inference; this may not change numeric rules or sample criteria
data.exclusions: v0 location missing; corrupt or ambiguous images may be replaced only before inference by frozen next-ranked eligible source, with reason logged

executionOrder: Freeze protocol, dataset recipe, image bytes, labels, split, independent background review and all SHA256 bindings
Run calibration images only through actual Android NativeMoveNet; do not inspect heldout predictions
Compute threshold once from calibration; freeze policy JSON including selected threshold or none, model/profile/protocol/manifest/prediction SHA256
Run or reveal heldout once with same binary/profile and frozen threshold; never reselect on heldout
Evaluate fresh independently annotated natural positive/negative clips and unchanged application regressions; retain all failures

labels.coordinateSystem: original decoded bitmap pixels matching COCO width/height; x/y not normalized, anatomical sides
labels.accuratePrimaryImage: all4 required point errors<=0.10; invalid mapping/nonfinite/native invalid score fails

visibilitySemantics.0: not labeled; no valid location, never a coordinate negative
visibilitySemantics.1: labeled but not visible; may still be accurately estimated, evaluate separately
visibilitySemantics.2: labeled and visible; primary point-estimate accuracy stratum

labels.rawAdmission: all4 points finite/in bounds, all4 raw native scores finite in[0,1], positive predicted shoulder span, minimum raw score>=threshold; do not filter by gesture geometry
labels.ambiguousLabels: retain and report separately; never turn model disagreement into a changed GT label

scoreSemantics.statistic: minimum of native scores at COCO indices5,6,9,10
scoreSemantics.meaning: uncalibrated MoveNet keypoint score; neither MediaPipe visibility/presence nor measured person/global probability

exploratorySelection.noFeasibleCandidate: record none; preserve baseline and do not relax rules after seeing predictions

exploratoryHeldoutAcceptance.interpretation: empirical debug-video research evidence only, wide finite-sample uncertainty; never production approval

additionalRequirements: independent natural temporal positives and hard negatives
full relevant negative video coverage and zero unexpected scored events
frontal6events/6rays/ACK6, lifecycle, revision/epoch, pause, realtimer and nonempty-progress regression protection

uncertainty.report: exact one-sided95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound separately for incorrect among admitted primary images and no-person admission among reviewed background images; full numerators/denominators and two-sided95% intervals where useful
uncertainty.calibrationGridCIs: descriptive only after grid selection; no unadjusted simultaneous coverage claim
uncertainty.deploymentCaveat: small curated COCO image pilot, source identity not guaranteed independent; not deployment prevalence or video-frame independence
uncertainty.doNotPoolBackgroundAndPrimary: sampling prevalence is constructed; report stratified risks/coverage

geometryDiagnostics.robustAnnotationClass: Only call GT left/right/neutral/bothup robust when every required signed GT margin exceeds its .26/.24 error bound; otherwise boundary-ambiguous for geometry, while point error remains reportable
geometryDiagnostics.assumption: bound concerns predictions within.10 of annotated point estimates, not unknown human annotation uncertainty
reportSeparately: false gesture events in natural clips

integrationIfJustified.nativeGate: PoseGestureMachine explicit immutable known policy; preserve baseline constructor=.65
integrationIfJustified.webGate: src/motion.js has a second.65gate; pass only validated pinned policy from trusted runtime/source context, never arbitrary packet/intent threshold
integrationIfJustified.diagnostics: NativePoseDiagnostics must use active policy and separately preserve baseline counters; report actual threshold
integrationIfJustified.noGlobalPersonProbability: never inflate event.confidence to.65; retain raw minimum and name policy explicitly

nativeStillHarness.placement: debug-only dedicated Activity or bounded batch entry point; same NativeMoveNet class, no WebView scoring or persistence
nativeStillHarness.assets: explicit compile-time/manifest-pinned local image list only, no arbitrary URI/network/camera
nativeStillHarness.decode: BitmapFactory ARGB_8888,inScaled=false,no EXIF autorotation; require exact source dimensions; no GT bbox crop
nativeStillHarness.profile: three same-image passes, reset per independent image; classify no synthetic holds and do not concatenate unrelated images into a video
nativeStillHarness.output: scalar imageId, source hash, model/profile ID, raw4scores, mapped4coordinates, invalid mapping flags, source dimensions and timing; no saved tensors/decoded image outputs
nativeStillHarness.memory: one bitmap at a time, recycle in finally, one worker, close interpreter on completion/Activity teardown
nativeStillHarness.referenceParity: reuse established parity; no perimage reference inference needed for unchanged192 path
nativeStillHarness.scope: Android static-image keypoint/gate evidence; not video tracking, application scoring or FireTV throughput

prohibitions: no threshold fit to existing clear/nearface/frontal acceptance fixtures
no using COCO visibility as accuracy or person probability
no training-set data claimed as independent calibration
no still-image concatenation/hold synthesis claimed as natural events
